description: This file provides utility functions for managing bundled plugin build entries, reading plugin package.json files, collecting plugin source entries, and handling plugin build artifacts in an OpenClaw build system.

methods.name: readBundledPluginPackageJson
methods.description: Reads and parses the package.json file for a plugin, returns null if not found or invalid JSON.

methods.name: isManifestlessBundledRuntimeSupportPackage
methods.description: Checks if a package qualifies as a manifestless bundled runtime support package based on its name and extensions.

methods.name: collectPluginSourceEntries
methods.description: Compiles a list of source file entries for a plugin based on its package.json configuration.

methods.name: shouldStageBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Determines if runtime dependencies should be staged based on plugin configuration.

methods.name: collectTopLevelPublicSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Gathers top-level public surface files (e.g., source code files) from a plugin directory, filtering out irrelevant or test files.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Aggregates build entries for all plugins found in the extensions root directory, considering manifest presence and configuration.

methods.name: listBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Lists build entries as a mapping from internal filename to their path within the bundled plugin directory.

methods.name: listBundledPluginPackArtifacts
methods.description: Returns a list of all artifacts (files) produced during the plugin build process, including JSON and JS files.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Lists runtime dependencies for all plugins that require their dependencies to be staged.
